learnings: Malaysia's flood problem is recurring and quantified at national level (RM6.1B in 2021, RM933M in 2024, RM637M in 2025) — but early-warning infrastructure is coarse: JPS sirens at area level, NaFFWS at river-basin level, commercial sensors at USD 234-504. A <RM150 community node with local mesh radio is a genuine price/coverage gap.

Demographics are deterministic: Malaysia crosses the 15%-aged (60+) line ~2030, in the middle of the 4-year product window. M40/T20 urban households (avg income RM8,479/mo, 2022) can afford RM100-150 devices; substitutes are either app-only (free) or imported watches (USD 100-200) with no local support.

EV charging is a policy-driven growth market (10,000-point target vs 3,600 actual at end-2024; +153%/yr) with a clear missing middle: affordable OCPP-certifiable controller silicon. The charger itself is RM2,800-7,000 (system market) while the controller module (our device) can sit at RM99-149.

Open-source wireless RTL is a verified gap: LoRa and BLE PHYs exist only as SDR software (gr-lora_sdr, SDR-LoRa) — no production-grade pure-Verilog transceiver RTL. Any of our candidates that needs wireless MUST CREATE it in-house; this is simultaneously the differentiation and the top technical risk.

SKY130 feasibility baseline is strong for MCU+SRAM+analog: Caravel-class user area 3.1x3.8mm, 50-100MHz, sky130B ships 1-2kB SRAM macros, OpenRAM extends to 32-64kB, PDK includes analog primitives. Prototype economics: USD 9,750 chipIgnite or free Google MPW.

The 3-tier AMBA requirement maps naturally: CPU + SRAM + DMA on AXI4-Lite, streaming datapaths (ADC capture, sensor FIFOs, radio packets, metrology) on AHB with DMA, and all control/status registers on APB. This is a genuine architectural requirement for all three candidates, not decoration.

SIRIM Type Approval is a known, bounded regulatory path for radio devices in Malaysia (MCMC label, 2-6 months); medical-device registration (MDA) is avoided by NOT making health claims on candidate B's marketing.

contradictions.claim_a: Malaysia becomes ageing nation by 2030 (60+ >= 15%) — DOSM projection via Malay Mail + MPRH
contradictions.claim_b: Malaysia becomes aged nation by 2048 — MOF/Amir Hamzah (65+ >= 20%)
contradictions.resolution: Different thresholds: 'ageing nation' (60+ >= 15%) hits 2030; 'aged nation' (65+ >= 20%) hits 2048. Both official. Candidate B's 4-year window (2026-2030) spans the 2030 crossing — timing claim uses the 2030 fact.

contradictions.claim_b: RM933.4M (2024) and RM636.9M (2025) — annual monsoon seasons
contradictions.resolution: Not a contradiction: 2021 was a 1-in-100-year event; annual losses are RM0.6-1B. Both cited; the pitch uses annual figures as baseline and 2021 as ceiling motivation.

contradictions.claim_a: Target 10,000 public charge points by end-2025 (Low Carbon Mobility Blueprint)
contradictions.claim_b: Actual: ~3,600 charge points at end-2024 (Roland Berger); ~1,000 stations per MOSTI quote (ChargeSINI)
contradictions.resolution: Target vs actual gap confirmed; station vs point definitions differ. Use Roland Berger's 3,600 points (T2) as the primary actual figure; the gap is the market opportunity.
Different scopes: BEV-only vs xEV (BEV+PHEV+HEV). Both official; use per-scope figures in the corpus and pitches.

validation_gaps: RF front-end feasibility on sky130 (433/915MHz for A, 2.4GHz for B) lacks a T1/T2 silicon-proven citation; labeled hypothesis (T5) with mitigation: external RF front-end module fallback, in-house digital baseband is the CREATE-IP core.
sky130A volume wafer pricing is not published; die-cost model at 130nm is a T4/T5 estimate cross-checked against chipIgnite prototype pricing (T1) and module BOMs (T1/T5).
Malaysia-specific elderly-device TAM has no official figure; sized bottom-up from DOSM household/ageing data (T1) + global market reports (T4) — labeled as model, not measured.
